whatIs: Navbar Gallery is a curated gallery dedicated only to the navigation bars of real sites. They're grouped by type (static, dropdown, mega menu, sidebar, search, announcement, fullscreen, and breadcrumbs), and each entry has a screenshot, a link to its own page, and another to the original site.
It's useful when you're deciding how to build a project's navigation and want to see many solutions to the same component.
uses: Looking at mega menu examples before implementing the navigation of a site with many sections.
Finding how others integrate a search box or an announcement in the top bar.
Checking how a sidebar or fullscreen navigation behaves on different sites.
caveats: It only covers navbars: there are no footers, heroes, or other sections.
Examples load in batches with the Load more button.
It shows screenshots, not code: you have to open the original site to see how it's built.
pricingNote: Free; anyone can submit a navbar to be added to the gallery.
idealFor: Anyone designing or implementing a site's navigation who is looking for references.
